notes: Governing documents: MSU Faculty Handbook pages (captures 2018-01-18), in force on the reference date 2018-02-24: Parental Leave (rev. 2017-01-01), Modified Duties (2011), Tenure Clock (rev. 2015-12-09), Medical Leave (2000), FMLA (undated, reference-year capture), Leave Policies (1993). missing = false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) condition not met: governing faculty documents are saved).

2018_00_link is a 2013 summary matrix for academic staff and fixed-term faculty (capture 2015-09-01); it restates the STD 6 weeks for the birth mother, 6 weeks parental leave and FMLA, but says two MSU parents get a 'combined total of 6 weeks', which the 2017 handbook policy replaced ('each may have six (6) weeks'). No component is coded from it; conflict flagged on c1.
2018_08 is the modified-duties application form (no policy terms beyond the primary/co-caregiver statement used for c7).
2018_07 covers benefit continuation during leave without pay and FMLA; no leave terms of its own (evidence for c11).

Chain, birth parent: short-term disability leave of absence (c2, up to 6 months) containing the paid childbirth period (c3, normally 6 weeks) -> paid parental leave 6 weeks (c1, consecutive_after c3) -> modified duties up to one semester, teaching relieved (c7, also_available with c1, in addition to the leaves); FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) concurrent with c2 and c1.
Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave 6 weeks (c1) -> modified duties up to one semester (c7, also_available); FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) concurrent with c1.

The STD footnote says the combination of Short Term Disability and Parental leave 'replaces the 12 weeks normally provided by the Maternity Leave policy, which has been discontinued'; the FMLA page calls it 'a 12-week leave provided under the short-term disability and parental leave policies'. Read as confirming the 6 + 6 order, not as a leave limit.

Documents cited but not saved: Long-Term Disability plan; 'Long-Term Disability: An Interpretation of the Tenure Rules'; 'Continuation of Benefits for Faculty on Leave of Absence No Pay Status to Receive Prestigious Awards, Fellowships and/or Special Assignment Opportunities' (not parental); Faculty Grievance Policy (not parental); Maternity Leave policy (stated as discontinued).
